title: Choose the smallest intervention that closes the measured gap
description: Compare prompting, retrieval, adapter SFT, and full fine-tuning against a versioned product scenario. The fit score explains the decision model; it is not a quality forecast.

scenarios.label: Support request routing
scenarios.detail: Produce one stable JSON schema and route labels from a bounded taxonomy.

scenarios.label: Policy assistant
scenarios.detail: Answer from policies that change weekly and cite the current approved source.

scenarios.label: Clinical note formatting
scenarios.detail: Convert approved facts into a stable specialist template without adding facts.

scenarios.label: Product copilot
scenarios.detail: Follow a stable tool protocol while using live inventory and account context.

evidenceStates.label: Anecdotes only
evidenceStates.detail: The team has examples of failures but no frozen rubric, baseline, or held-out slices.

evidenceStates.label: Prompt baseline
evidenceStates.detail: The task rubric and prompt baseline exist, but retrieval and training-data rights are unproven.

evidenceStates.label: Release evidence ready
evidenceStates.detail: Prompt and retrieval baselines, grouped holdouts, slice gates, provenance, and data rights are versioned.

priorities.label: Fast iteration
priorities.detail: Prefer reversible changes that can be evaluated without a training run.

priorities.label: Shorter prompts
priorities.detail: Repeated demonstrations consume enough context or latency to justify adaptation.

priorities.label: Isolated behavior
priorities.detail: The release needs a separately versioned behavior artifact with an explicit rollback target.

strategies.label: Define the contract first
strategies.detail: Freeze task, rubric, slices, baseline, and data rights before choosing an optimization.
strategies.nextStep: Create representative held-out cases and record the current prompt/model result.

strategies.label: Prompt and examples
strategies.detail: Keep weights unchanged; improve instructions, examples, output validation, and tool contracts.
strategies.nextStep: Run the frozen eval against a smaller, clearer prompt and schema validator.

strategies.label: Retrieval-augmented generation
strategies.detail: Keep current facts outside model weights and evaluate retrieval and generation separately.
strategies.nextStep: Build an oracle-recall baseline before changing model weights.

strategies.label: SFT with LoRA or PEFT
strategies.detail: Train a small adapter for stable behavior while preserving a separately versioned base model.
strategies.nextStep: Pilot an adapter against the same frozen baseline and release gates.

strategies.label: Full-parameter SFT
strategies.detail: Update the base weights only after a PEFT baseline shows a measured capability or capacity limit.
strategies.nextStep: Justify the larger training and release surface with a controlled PEFT comparison.
